headword: {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}

definitions.explanation: Food that has been preserved by freezing and is stored at very low temperatures. Includes ready-made meals, vegetables, meat, and other items.

examples.english: I heat up frozen food in the microwave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦とき→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧。

notes:
Compound of ⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧ (freezing) + ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ (food product). Covers ready-made meals, frozen vegetables, meat, and other items stored at low temperatures.
